verdict.rationale: xAI documentation is agent-native by design: llms.txt exists and returns HTTP 200 with a structured summary of the docs (grok-probe-1), and doc pages are directly accessible in .md format (all grok-docs-* URLs), confirmed live via probes. xAI even hosts a dedicated MCP server giving agents direct access to its documentation (grok-docs-24), reinforcing agent-friendly doc access. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that an external agent successfully consumed llms.txt end-to-end (only first-party/probe evidence).
